SELECT boat, count(*) n_trips, sum(yt) total_yt, sum(anglers) total_anglers, sum(yt)/sum(anglers) rate
FROM trips
WHERE cls='three_quarter' AND fish_date_season=2 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 91 AND 121
GROUP BY boat
ORDER BY total_anglers DESC
SELECT index_id, value, avail_doy FROM climate WHERE index_id='oni' ORDER BY avail_doy DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT value, avail_doy FROM climate WHERE index_id='oni' AND avail_season=2 ORDER BY avail_doy DESC LIMIT 6

import pandas as pd
trips = tables['trips']
climate = tables['climate']

# latest ONI trend
oni = climate[climate.index_id=='oni'].sort_values('value_t' if 'value_t' in climate.columns else climate.columns[0])
oni_cols = [c for c in climate.columns if 'doy' in c or 'season' in c or c=='value']
oni_recent = oni[oni_cols].tail(8)

# season2 vs season1 three_quarter Apr-Jun (doy 91-181), overall rate
tq = trips[trips.cls=='three_quarter']
def rate(df):
    return df.yt.sum()/df.anglers.sum() if len(df) else None
s1 = tq[(tq.fish_date_season==1) & (tq.fish_date_doy>=91) & (tq.fish_date_doy<=181)]
s2 = tq[(tq.fish_date_season==2) & (tq.fish_date_doy>=91) & (tq.fish_date_doy<=181)]
s1_rate, s2_rate, s1_n, s2_n = rate(s1), rate(s2), len(s1), len(s2)

# current season2 boat-level three_quarter rates, last 21 days (doy 100-121)
recent2 = tq[(tq.fish_date_season==2) & (tq.fish_date_doy>=100) & (tq.fish_date_doy<=121)]
boat_rates = recent2.groupby('boat').apply(lambda d: pd.Series({'n':len(d),'yt':d.yt.sum(),'anglers':d.anglers.sum(),'rate':d.yt.sum()/d.anglers.sum() if d.anglers.sum() else 0})).sort_values('rate', ascending=False)

# HD classes season2 check, last 21 days
hd2 = trips[(trips.cls.isin(['hd_am','hd_pm'])) & (trips.fish_date_season==2) & (trips.fish_date_doy>=100) & (trips.fish_date_doy<=121)]
hd_rate = rate(hd2)

result = {
  'oni_recent': oni_recent.to_dict('records'),
  's1_apr_jun_tq_rate': s1_rate, 's1_n': s1_n,
  's2_apr_jun_tq_rate': s2_rate, 's2_n': s2_n,
  'boat_rates_last21d': boat_rates.to_dict('index'),
  'hd_rate_last21d_s2': hd_rate, 'hd_n': len(hd2),
}
